caller_tactics.text: Hello, is this Eszter Varga? This is Joanne Pike from Tarrow Mutual Insurance. I'm calling about your annual review for your home policy.
Nothing urgent. I just want to check that the cover still matches your home and contents.
Your renewal date is in June, and the premium is shown on the letter. It went up slightly because of general rebuilding costs.
Building materials cost more across the country, so insurers adjust their premiums. That's noted in the renewal summary.
We'd suggest a rebuild estimate, which you can use to compare with the current sum insured. I can post a form for you to fill in.
Yes, a monitored alarm can reduce the premium. You'd need to tell us the make and model, and we can check the discount.
That's fine. Keep the box or the manual if you can. No need to change anything today.
The excess is shown on page two of the renewal summary. It's still two hundred and fifty dollars for accidental damage.
Please do. If you'd like to make any changes, call us before the renewal date in June.
